pages.title: Jan Aushadhi stores at all GGHs in AP

facts.text: Decision: AP Health Dept to set up Jan Aushadhi stores in all Government General Hospitals (GGHs)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Review: 16 GGHs — 23 private medical stores; margins 50%–600%; Nandyal GGH had none; stocked only 30–40% essential generics
facts.head: News

facts.text: PM-BJAP: profit margin capped at 15%; software by Department of Pharmaceuticals
facts.head: News

facts.text: Branded drugs: only with prior approval when no generic exists
facts.head: News

facts.text: Oversight: District Collectors (who head local Red Cross branches)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Next: feasibility for District and Area Hospitals
facts.head: News

facts.text: Signed by: G. Veerapandian, Commissioner of Health & FW and Mission Director, NHM
facts.head: Emergency preparedness directive

facts.text: Measures: stocks of medicines, oxygen, blood, trauma kits; all leaves cancelled; district nodal officers; 24x7 control rooms; CBRN (Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear) preparedness
facts.head: Emergency preparedness directive
